text: things were going fine until I lost access to my account. now im in the process of recovering it but the customer service is terrible. they asked for screenshots, game id and purchase receipts and after providing all they have not replied to my email (I have sent 4 more since) in close to 24 hours. it is like they have just decided to ignore me. the game is great but the customer service bring the score right down as we may need help with anything in-game and they just dont seem to care.

Game is actually decent, but the ads are fake. Nothing like the actual game. This is actually a castle building strategy game, which isn't shown anywhere in the photos! There's mini-games similar to the shooting barrels one shown, but they're very basic and lower quality. EDIT AFTER DEV REPLY: No, that's a blatant lie! Reduced to 1*. I played every aspect of the game that wasn't behind a pay wall for months, it's NOTHING like these images. You don't even include a photo of the main game!

This is even worse than the rest of its genre. I have never been forced to pay so early in a game. If you don't spend diamonds on a second building slot, you get completely blocked, unable to move forward in any way. Tbh, I only started playing in order to compare it to puzzles and Survival, and it's the same old thing. There are slight differences in graphics and storyline, but all of these games are the same!! Uninstall!!!

Evony's core mechanics are almost the exact same as the rest of the RTS games but it has so many extra features that it adds it's own unique take on this genre. Unfortunately, after purchasing packages (oops) for the game I was hit with a wave of bugs, making the game unplayable - stuck connecting. The game itself is very fun and I would recommend. However, I would not purchase anything in-game due to the poor code involved. Don't want your money wasted.

Ignore the false advertising, this is not a "solve the puzzle" game and the puzzles that are there don't have the fancy graphics as shown in the adverts! This is a multiplayer war game where you build your city/troops over time to combat other players/alliances and servers. As you increase your level, a few more puzzles are available to play but the rewards offered are miserly at best and not worth the effort! For a war game it's good, but don't download it thinking its all puzzles!!

Edited, in response: There was an ad for this game that made a big deal about how the game was exactly what was shown in the ad, unlike other games. This was seriously misleading. The puzzles are wrapped in a generic freemium city building setup. You build a barracks, upgrade etc. These take time to complete, you can presumably pay to speed it up etc. The advertised puzzle game is buried beneath all of this and blocked by it. I never got to the point of an interesting puzzle.

Downloaded this after suffering the adverts over 200 times, because I wanted to try the logic puzzles. The puzzles are just a small part of the game. I am not interested in a city building war game and just want the puzzles. You have to progress through the game levels to do the puzzles, so after getting to level 7 and rewarded with just 3 puzzles, I gave up!!

If you want a kingdom building game, it's not the worst one. Although it gets very slow as it grinds on and it's really quite generic. If you're looking at it because the ads inticed you in, don't waste another moment and just leave it. Despite the pleas of the developers' internet slaves, the puzzles are nothing like what's in the ads and moreso you only get to do a handful of them when you level up. Which is something that can take months of play later on. Avoid unless you love the grind.

Pure unvarnished, unfiltered, pointless addiction-forming, addiction-reinforcement. Encouraged through repetition on top of pointless repetition. I'm one of a lucky few, who'd made it out, and is now on the other side. This game advertises itself as a simple shoot-em-up, when it's actually a command and conquer, war game, that's has no end goal. Plus, you're required to ALWAYS be logged in, to protect your kingdom. This game is a catfishing TRAP! Steer clear, and keep on driving!!👏🏾😱🤮

Had to change my review from 5 stars to 1 stars. The game use to be good and a pretty even playing field for both coiners and free players. but now it seems all they want is more and more money. I've had alot of friends leave the game who are free players. Our server is left with only coiners including myself I was one of those. I have now made the hard decision to leave the game and no longer fill your pockets with my hard earned money.

Game constantly advertises the main game as something it isn't. Going entirely off of ads, you expect this game to be a cute little puzzle game, but instead you're greeted with a base builder and 500 micro-transactions. As of writing, the icon on the play store is what you'd see on its (untrue) advertisements. When you see this, do you expect to be thrown into a game designed around base building? No! Devs, you have talent, and you're wasting it to lie to people. You're pathetic. Seek help.

The ad for this game is misleading. When will you guys realise that honesty is the best policy. I played for several weeks trying to get to the so-called great puzzles. After weeks of building and generally boring content, I did find one ok puzzle. I can't wait until google implements the new false advertising rule. This will force development teams to be honest and fair in your advertising. Have a great day. 👎

Terrible game, also falsely advertised, don't waste your time and money, I can 100% guarantee you will regret it! Like I and many others. I think it's very misleading and devious the way the game is advertised, when the actual gameplay resembles nothing in the advertisment 🤔🤔 isn't false advertisement illegal? But misleading advertisement just perfectly acceptable?? 😒 Not to mention all the bugs, lagging, crashes, constant resetting of the game. Save your time/stress, play something else.

An utter waste of time. Downloaded for the advertised puzzle games which only constitute about 1% (if that) of actual game time. The main bulk of the game is basically a hard-to-navigate, clunky free-for-all PvP version of Age of Empires 1, but somehow, in 2023, with LESS customization. It seems like the players who have put the most real money into the game somehow dictate unmoderated servers, and the pay-to-play aspect of it is sickening. I played for a few days, got to lvl 18. Not worth it.

As others have stated - despite the multiple ads - the puzzles are only a minor side quest of the game. The fact they have invested in a multiple ad campaign that professes "Don't you hate it when you see those ads and download the game but it isn't the same shown?" They don't show ANY of the main game - only the side quest puzzles which you can only do a few of before having to pay. Why the developers don't just make a game called "Evony the Kings Return - Just the Puzzles" I don't know

I've never seen such a pathetic excuse for a game. It's simple, DO WHAT YOU'RE ADVERTISING. Just a simple endless fight against monsters with options to improve your weapons, that's all I need and what YOU advertised. But no, it's a horribly made RPG game that requires upgrading all of these castles to actually play the game and nonstop pauses with dialogue from characters no one gives a damn about.

A lot of people end up in this game because of the puzzles in the advert. This is not the game. It's a city building war game at the surface but underneath it's a gambling game. If you get suckered into paying, you can spend more than you realise very quickly. If you are susceptible to any form of adictive play, I would highly recommend avoiding this game like the plague. The devs only carre about income, not players or quality. Enjoy or not (not is better for your health). Choose health!

This is a war strategy game with other players, who spend serious money to play. I'm talking about hundreds of pounds every month. If you are unwilling to make that financial commitment, don't bother. You'll just get hammered. The puzzle game it is advertised as being is a very tiny and not relevant feature. I played for a year, at that point buildings take years to complete and training troops become crazy expensive. It's not fun anymore.

Not the game advertised. The puzzles as advertised may well be in the game but are no way the main feature of it. It looks like a lot of work has gone into designing the puzzles, so why they are so inaccessible is beyond me. If it is a strategy game that involves upgrading your keep, it should be advertised as such: NOT as a puzzle game.

I wasn't expecting this type of game according to the ads. However the puzzles do exist in game, the graphics are great but once the protection is off it's a free-for-all. I got raided by players who were well over my power range whilst I was offline, (living in the real world, working etc.) So even if I was online I wouldn't have stood a chance. I think it should be within the same power range to make it fairer and a PVE option.

Very poor. Ads are misleading and dev responses inaccurate. Yes, there are some pull the pin puzzles but they are if very poor design, animation quality and of no actual point to the game. This is the most generic city/army builder ever made (and I'm sure there used to be a browser game of the same name in the late 90's/early 00's). After the initial tutorial phase they are few and far between. It's not a Puzzle game and the ads are very misleading.

What you see advertised is 1% of the game. The majority of the game is clicking the x button of prompts to buy things in the game. Essentially, the game revolves around building a fortress by doing things to level up. Unfortunately, if you get the game, you are new. This means experienced people will, on a daily basis, destroy your base, making you lose your resources. But guess what, you can buy traces and this will stop that! If you want to wait days weeks for your next upgrade play on

The ads are absolutely nothing like the game. I got to level 29 which took 6 months and cost money (it would have taken a lot longer otherwise) and I still haven't seen any of the puzzles in the advert. The game is really about server vs server wars (capture the flag) but with weird rock-paper-scissors-talisman battle dynamics. The daily 6 puzzles are just repeats of ones seen at the end of level, and the length of time you spend at each level after 25 means you see the repeats A LOT!!!

It's a pay to win game! If you're planning to join to have fun, keep in mind you'll never be able to keep up with older players. Considering there's a 3 day war where even a 1 billion level player can attack a low level. Taking their resources and killing their general. You'll never be able to keep up!! Your power points will drop, you'll need to heal your troops/city which costs a ton of resources + weeks/months the more troops you had!

This game is mainly for pay-to-play, as you can't get very far quickly. It's also non-cohesive; they throw in random events that have nothing to do with the game style to make more money. The puzzles are a joke at lower levels; you get about ten puzzles per level up and six daily puzzles that take 60 seconds to complete. The reward is poor. The game is basically a very poor strategy war game with poor graphics, and it's very toxic on a lot of servers caused by big coiners.

Customer service is rubbish, and for a free to play game, surely does require a lot of money for prosperity. But main issue is that there is no care for customers by the decelopers, if something good is released, they quickly reduce it and give out a mail that ot is not working as intended. The only thing intended is for you to open your wallet and spend. Also there is no clear manual on how the game mechanics work, that's down to the player to discover while paying for it.

Not like the ad. Advertised as a pull-the-pin logic puzzle game, but is only a tiny part, as its actually mostly a Civilization like strategy game and none of that is in the ads. I don't understand why they advertise so aggressively, yet offer a fundamentally different game to what they advertise? If people come for the puzzles, make a game of just that.

Enjoyable yes but a severe money pit of a game in a time where there is a cost of living crisis globally. Any new content has been designed to make you spend even more money rather than fix bugs & fix lag. If you don't want to be cannon fodder expect to spend around 25k in first year playing (home deposit kind of money) The disparity between those that spend that kind of money and those that don't is so colossal that unless you intend spending money there is no point playing this game at all.

Waste of time. Every single day someone comes along and attacks....while all the troops I've trained die. What is the point of troops exactly?? Why have I bothered? It's not a puzzle game...its worthless world building with a couple of puzzle sections. I don't want to meet people all over the world. I'll go on a chat app if I want to chat. I wanted to play the puzzle game you falsely advertised. Shame I can't take my 1 star rating back! I've deleted it and will never recommend it.

DO NOT PLAY THIS WAR GAME. Please do not play. It's not a puzzle game. It's a war game that costs loads and loads of money. And once you spend money the developers go into your account and take out what you've brought and then demand more payments for your stuff back you've actually paid money for. AND IM BEING DEADLY SERIOUS. It's a fraudulent game across most countries. Even when you make it to the top level in all stars the game doesn't work. The servers crash and customers service ignore you

Avoid!!! Don't waste time playing this game. Customer support is the worse support by far I have ever experienced. They lie and don't pay out compensation for the issues or lost items. Customer support constantly hassle you to rate them 5 stars review in exchange for a gift. Every 12 months they release a new 5 levels. this makes you save resources in the billions to upgrade. currently it's from level 30 to 35. then they have the cheek to give you 5000 resources as a server gift.

The puzzle game used in the adverts makes up a tiny percentage of what the fane actually is. Extremely deceitful advertising. Edit: Dear developer, I have no interest in a game where I have to play a completely different (and truly awful) game in order to upgrade my keep so that I can play the game that was advertised. Your advertising doesn't mention a microtransaction heavy strategy game, it shows nothing but a puzzle game that is barely even present in what you're actually selling. You lied.

To be honest, I installed the game to see if the 'Puzzles' advertised by this games terrible Ads that pop up every 2 videos did the terrible quality of the game Justice, and they do. I want an explanation from the developers of the game as to why they mean to insult our intelligence by advertising the game to be hard. Being a mobile game is not an excuse for how bad it is. Over advertised, underwhelming in animation and gameplay and is almost a copy and paste of games like Age of War.

The game is probably a decent game, to some people, but the adverts do my head in. I downloaded coz the adverts got the better of me, and within the first 5 minutes of playing it wasn't even the same game advertised. I don't have mission after mission of saving the golf from the beast for the guy. Do a real advert, showing what you do in the game and then I may continue to use it.

I've been playing for about a month or so. I was just expecting puzzles like on YouTube ad, but there's so much more to the game! I've found a great alliance to play with and help me learn and grow. You can definitely grow without paying for packs/gems, as long as you're in a strong alliance it's easy. On your own it is very difficult tho. The only thing that annoys me is the updates sometimes don't work smoothly for me. I've reinstalled the game twice because of this.

False advertising. All videos of the ad campaign show those neat pull-the-pin logic puzzles, but that's not at all what the game is about. You have to endure some overly complicated empire building game with lots of attempts to take your money, and only then you get to play a couple of logic puzzles occasionally. Rubbish. Not worth my time.

Installed this as the adverts sell it as a puzzle style game with lots of interesting puzzles. There are some but not as advertised. Not worth the hassle, other games do it better. Avoid. Response to your comment. Where in the adverts are the strategy elements explained? How does your advert accurately reflect the gameplay experience? Response to comment: no response from you, so assume you can't find anywhere in the ad that explains the strategy elements. False advertising

I installed and played this game for about a year. There are puzzles, but not as many as the adverts suggest, plus players at a much higher level can attack your "settlement" constantly causing severe damage and costing you months of in-game building. I get this happens in most games, but other game dynamics give a cooling off period between enemy attacks, so it's not constant. (To be fair this was a while back). I couldn't be bothered with playing anymore. And no, I don't miss it.

Very little of the gameplay is reflected by the ads. 99% of what you do on this game is basically timer management with buildings, and pretty much every single aspect of the game including the events and cash grab pop-ups is timegated. I am sure that anyone who sees the ads of going side to side shooting the monsters expects to be doing that most of the time, since that would be actually entertaining. I felt the FOMO and cut it off after a few days, and will not be reinstalling this game.

Edit. Since im not the first to complain about the wrong ad vs. game. Maybe YOU should fix it. Why keep a game that i dont like, that isnt as the ad says. It says NOTHING ABOUT HAVING TO DO QUESTS. I NEVER WOULD HAVE DOWNLOADED IT, IF IT DID. I installed the game because of the ad. I did not want to do quests. THAT is not what the ad shows. It shows shooting barrels and people. Don't waste your time. I'm not anymore. I wanted the shooting part of the game, no a quest game. Disappointed.

The best 4x game I've played so far 💯. You can change various cultures etc when you wish. Game musics are relaxing. Quite all generals are from real life history, except few as special features. I reinstalled it the other day and I see the graphics are even better now, without lagging. You can unlock goals too from play games. Meanwhile I found other similar games really stressful to play, playing this game is not a stress for me. The "champion girls" should be called "beauties" btw.

The game itself is a fun strategy, empire building game. The ads on the otherhand are completely fake and don't properly show gameplay. There are no zombies or shooting anything and there were only a few levels of "puzzles" that were repetitive. After a certain point, you also almost have to pay to continue leveling up.

Screws you on big things, throwing away major gear when u've clearly designated not to, repeatedly over course of years. They don't care about fixing many issues, or recouping you. Recently had the strange experience of it purchasing something for $99 while the game wasn't even loaded, & they didn't even bother responding about it. Now I made 2nd acct & went back, & the email link option isn't even there🤣. No way to fix online - just error message. Seems designed to waste people's time?🗑

This game is all about getting you to spend but you get absolutely nothing in return, without purchasing packages you will grow too slow and live under a truce agreement or risk being attacked all the time. after 10 years playing this game I think I'm just about ready to give it up. there no incentives to keep anyone playing. servers are all empty your lucky if you have 2 big alliances per server I mean really lucky. I'm just hoping that another developer will bring out a game like this.

Soon as i updated, i cannot play consistently for more than 30 minutes, the game just kicks out. I had a hard time during svs, game would just kick me out while im on the enemy servers luckily i didnt get zeroed twice. Make f2p players great again, with all these updates they are focused on the coiners. F2P players like me are getting left behind badly, i know im not the only one whos starting to lose interest. Its bad.

Don't download this game unless you have Extremely deep pockets and are willing to spend £1000s a week. if you wanna compete with other players it's the only way! as an example to obtain a civ gear costs approx 30,000,000 diamonds to purchase them it would cost $10000 how is this justified

this game has its ups and downs and I have finally made it to the higher levels of pvp within the game itself. Many people assume you must pay to win or that its pay to progress. The only payment that needs to get done out of convenience is an automatic rally card subscription that costs 10$ usd or just a slightly complex auto clicker. This game is much more about how you build your troops on an individual micro level to the point where a f2p can beat a top 1% p2w if they dont build correctly.

The game would be 5 stars if the development team didn't play favoritism towards some people, allowing some to use scripting and third party apps. Terms and service says it's a violation but some players can admit they're cheating, saying exactly that, and the development team will say there is no evidence. What evidence do you need if the person admits to cheating? Do not play this game! The development team does not allow fair and competitive gameplay!

I've been playing this game since 2022 and I'm 2b power and I buy packs and stuff to build troops and make gear and upgrade buildings and generals, I love this game. every other weekend there is a server war aka SvS and you battle other servers and some players have really big accounts and you can win lots of great things needed to play. you just wanna make sure you stay bubbleded for protection cuz if not players can attack you and kill all your troops and plunder all your resources.

awesome graphic friendly players and always something new to learn, that being said if you want to be towards the top 25% of players expect to pay and understand that someone will always outspend you. I eventually quit playing because it became too expensive to keep up with the other players. during the 3 years I played I met some of my best friends and still keep in touch with afterwards. hoping to someday to be able to afford to play again.

Secure your data streams. With unsecured data streams, Iscout and similar websites run rampant. Very fun game, the larger players that spend $ can help the lower ones who don't, which is cool...but to be very strong, you need to spend some $... which makes sense for any game really. Secure your data streams! Until then, one star is the most I can give.

I always seen the ads but ive finally checked it out. Im hooked the storyline is amazing. The prices are great, and we'll worth what you get. I recommend very much. Hats off to the developers and their staff. You did a fantastic job.

This is an ok time killer but littered with attempts to get you to spend money and seems to be designed to get up to spend as much money as possible. The deeper you go, the more it slows you down to get you to spend more money. The "actually gameplay" advertisements seem to be lies. I'm 25 levels in and have never seen the gameplay that is shown in the ads. Similar in some ways, but completely different in major ways.

Heavy coiners game (Some really drop 5k US$ a month in it as there is no other way to keep going), you must login minimal once every 3 days, no skills needed. This is not a puzzle game, far from that, it is a pure war game. Try to be smart and do not start to put real money in this game. Customer support is one of the worsed you can imagine. Be aware that dissapointments are common in this game and fair play is not around. Still willing to play, then have fun as long it last.

Enables PvP terrorism, nothing you can do. Don't waste your time... EDIT: Insincere bot response from developer, you'd have to be brain dead not to easily imagine how to solve such problems. My feedback thus far of course ignores their sleazy pay model app design and inability to get customer data deleted if you already uninstalled and no longer have auto generated alphanumeric user ID for their data deletion request form...

It is one of the best strategy games by far. But unfortunately, they make it impossible to defend. The game mechanics all favor the attacking players. Even with superb upgrades and defense, your keep will be flattened in minutes. EVONY - what is with the performance issues? The red wifi signal makes it impossible to play with consistency. Other players in other countries have the same complaints, so don't point it to being my device or my network. Game performance is 1 star.

Updates just before every server war starts and are always glitchy. This is NOT a puzzle game. There are puzzles but it is not the main focus of the game. This is a player vs player and player vs monster game. The enjoyability of the game is directly connected to which server you end up on. Edit to reply to automated creator response: You have too much new content each week. Customer Service is only for those who spend $$$. This is also the only way you win. Not for under age 18 years.

**Subject:** Research completes but shows Network Issue and resets, wasting Speedups Dear Evony Support Team, I am facing a serious and recurring bug with Research in the game. **Problem Description:** When my research time finishes, instead of completing successfully, a "network issue" symbol appears. After that, the research timer resets and starts again from the beginning and I lost my speedups.p

Update 5/26; Customer service has improved, I had an in game issue get resolved, and have had alliance members get help successfully too. I do wish there were more opportunities for free to play and low money spending players to compete with each other in battle events, and that there was more incentive for players to participate in server war. The power difference between players is massive and too risky for most players to participate against players who spent +$100k.

I've played this game for years and they have changed the game horribly. im literally stuck at k31 because even playing the game all week for hours at a time and gathering its hard to get upgrading resources. this used to be my all time favorite game too. each time you level up they go up on how much it costs to train soldiers and its like 17 million resources to upgrade troops! I just opened like 100 or more high lvl monster chests from joining rallies and was able to upgrade 1 building. p2p!

Evony is a pay to win game that will not be great for non coiners. I have played the game, and the grind effects are no longer a way of progressing with players spending thousands and bot farms going unpunished. but they say they punish bot farms, but thats not true. You still allow people to bot, and the level between coiners and non coiners is vaste . Their is a paywall to success be cheaper to buy a games console and play fallout 76.

Game is not like shown in Ads. whatever shown in Ads is just a miniscule part of game totally misleading. gameplay is good but they should be honest in giving information about the game. if you got money you can rule in the game. no money you will just need to crawl slowly in gameplay. most importantly customer service is non existent. typical system generated responses and hopeless responses. they will say we have not played the game fully when we question their inefficiency

This has been one of the worst gaming experiences I've had. I received multiple warnings despite believing I did nothing wrong, and every attempt to get a clear explanation from support was a waste of time. The responses felt dismissive and completely unhelpful. The game environment has also become increasingly unpleasant. Fairness and consistency seem to be lacking. Would recommend everyone not to waste your time on this!!

horrid customer service....would give less than 1 star if I could. DO NOT INSTALL THIS GAME. They take your money then insist you use a email to link it...even offering 1k gems if you use a email...guess what...using emails won't link you game even though they tell you it will. They just take your money and leave you without a account. So happy to see a class action lawsuit being filed against Evony for deceptive practices...hope they pay so much in fines that they have to close the game.

The text entry box in the chat function usually doesn't relocate to above the on-screen keyboard, thereby making it impossible to see what you're typing because the keyboard is covering it. VERY frustrating. When switching between apps and then back to this game, it often takes this game a long time to re-sync. Get a notification on your phone from another app, check it, then return to Evony and then be forced to wait up to or more than a minute while this game reacquires their server. 👎

Decent game but beware of deception. They charged me $50 for a prize package that I did not order. After being notified immediately, their response (4 days later) was that purchases are non-refundable. Follow-up: After giving the requested info, I was emailed by them repeating their original reply. I had to cancel my credit card to ensure this no longer happens.

Great game , but they focus too much on players that spend money and they kind of ruin the game that way , nobody in their right mind should have to pay eight hundred dollars for a castle skin , it's ridiculous. if you want to have stuff like that available for people that spend a lot of money, that's fine, but there are pretty much 0 options for people that cannot afford to spend that much money.

Game is trash. They allow high dollar players to bot but dont give the same opportunities for mid to low spenders. which makes and even bigger gap between the players. I would never recommend this game to anyone. The customer service is terrible too. 👎👎👎👎

Can't access app settings without completing their stupid tutorials so you can't disconnect your accounts before completing their setup games. The app literally has no settings available to users at all until they've completed multiple rounds. They don't offer compensation for not providing awards or app glitches.

Downloaded the app to give a 1 star review for how annoying your marketing is. The ads you put on other apps are so long and annoying. I'd LITERALLY rather count ceiling tiles in a wait room than play your game simply because of how much your game annoys me while trying to enjoy other apps.

Constant updates that glitch game play. Without spending $1000's of dollars weekly, you won't go far in it. As soon as you level, they change and now want ever more ridiculous amounts of things to be able to even PVP. The puzzles DO NOT EXIST, constant pop ups for more money, and customer service is basically non-existent, and you will conveniently glitch and lose everything. All designed to try to get you to spend more money. Greed ruined strategy. PAY TO WIN ONLY.

No ftp in this game, the new update eliminates them and allows whales to completely dominate smaller players. I spent 3 years playing this game only to have all my work destroyed by the update allowing keeps to reach level 50. Seriously disgusted with this game. That's absolutely incorrect. it doesn't matter how big my alliance is and I know because I'm in a huge one. My keep will lose to anything bigger than keep that's a level 45, Even if I'm being enforced with someone bigger.

DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY My friend spent 3 yrs playing this game and built their own Alliance, which isn't easy. His mother was ill so he did not play for just under a week (6 day 23 hours) 1 hour under their 7 day rule, but they still transferred the account to someone else who had joined the Alliance 3 days before. Customer Services say there is nothing they can do, which is a total lie. They made the mistake they should be able to rectify it. DON'T DOWNLOAD ANY 'TOP GAMES' APPS.

still having major issues with game! now I can't even get past the load screen. I'm done with this! been playing this game for over several years. going to lose all progress. sent several messages to the support. nothing has changed.

the intro sucks, its just too long and kinda stupid bc we cant skip it, cant chat/ask anyone, need to wait till k6 to even access the settings. pls give option to login or new player so it wont waste players time, especially the ones that needs to reinstall multiple times for whatever reason.

While the game starts like the ads, and there is one very small aspect of the game which money doesn't matter, if you want to build your keep and be competitive battling other players expect to spend tens of thousands of dollars. There is no way to play free and expect to be competitive over the long term.

This game is completely horrible, i paid and was the topper in sub city clue event, invested all my clue on japan subordinate city, at the end of the event the city goes to some one else and i get a arabic subcity for being in first place what is wrong with this people, they don't respect some ones money and cheat openly, if there was an option to post the pictures here i would have done it but my bad it doesn't support. horrible game app.

can't give less than 1 star. No customer support, just automated messages about giving more details, even if you tell them everything. A lot of chaos and disorganization in events.. you are going to miss rewards. guaranteed. Heavily pay to compete.. (servers are full of greedy ignoramouses) not even win. the ads about the game are lies. nothing in the ads is in the game. this game sucks.

came to experience the exact game the ad is advertising only to find out it's just another copy paste style time/strategy game you have to spend thousands on. if you came to play the game in the ads turn around and don't look back. games like this just waste your money and time. edit: if it was like the ads it would be single player and a simple game try again.

Don't trust the 4.5 rating. Hit 1 star reviews, start scrolling and lmk if you can make it to the end.

False advertising. Yes, those puzzles are IN the game but this is not a puzzle game. It's an empire building game like war craft. As you level up you get access to more puzzle games you can Doon the side to get item for the real game. Idk why they never show ads for the actual game. It's fun but it has a ton of micro transactions. So don't get this if you think those puzzles are the main game because they are not.

This used to be and could still be one of the most fun games... But not any more. Every release, they keep increasing the volume of content coming out, making it incredibly hard to sort through and keep up with... And that's when it's working. They seem to have stopped testing their releases though, and now each release is increasingly plagued with several bugs, making the game unplayable. This latest release, 4.29, is no exception. Until they start beta testing again, recommend gaming elsewhere

If you are looking for a skill based strategy game or a good puzzle game, keep looking. THIS ISN"T IT. There are more gambling elements than strategy. Packs regularly exceed 100 USD for a CHANCE to win "someting". If you think you'll grind away as a F2P player, nope! I know people in the game who regularly spend thousands of dollars to stay competitive at mid-level (not because they really want to). The biggest players spend even more because if they take a break, they might lose everything.

They make it look like this is the game, it's not. Evony is a town building game where you fight other players towns, most of the time youre just looking at timers. It's designed to cost you 100s of dollars to be competitive. Contrary to the dev response. There is more than one way, first is to constantly pump in money, the second is to become a farm for those that spend money. You can not progress or survive without spending money.

If you're looking for a puzzle game, this isn't it. This is a war game. One that is super laggy and glitch during every SVS or battlefield war event. One that they always ask you to "send screenshots" but never do anything to upgrade either their servers or the app to resolve the lag and glitches. One in which they have JUST released a new update that 75% of the players don't want. One that you won't be able to achieve without spending major money on. Don't waste your time or money on this.

I really love this game and have been playing since it came out. Only issue is the server I'm on. The ratio of coiners to players without that ability is about 10:1. It's finally got to a point where if you aren't a member of one particular alliance you cannot progress. Long story short, this game is quickly progressing to soley relying on in-app purchases. Basically it is losing my interest particularly fast. My advice do not join server 29.

After playing this game for awhile, I highly don't recommend playing it. Especially if you're here because of the puzzle ads. Despite the artistic culture and strategy, the developers have turned this into a thousand dollar pay to play game. Each event costs excessive resources to heal and upgrade the kingdom, and our current server is in disarray due to the current overpowered leadership.

Absolutely awful game. The UI is cluttered and not user friendly (and ugly) making playing the game a confusing mess. I spent 3 hours playing the game and I still have no idea what my objective was. The puzzled used in the ads and on the store page are just a tiny part of the game. It's some kind of base management/ war strategy game, I think. The developers will probably comment on this saying it's not false advertising, but it is. Don't bother playing.

So boring. Would be fun if it was just the puzzles, but the whole Kingdom fantasy roleplay whatever you call it is SO BORING! After 10 minutes I was fast asleep... And it's the middle of the day!! I know the ads are designed to trigger you to make you want to download it and prove to some imaginary person that's not even watching that it's actually easy. But this game triggered me more that the stupid ads did!! I wish I was a hacker so I could delete this game from the Play store, but I'm not.

Like all the other reviews before me... The ads for this game, while not an outright blatant lie, are at best misleading. The vendors replies are canned cut and paste nonsense. Not long after the "tutorial" you begin to experience the pay wall and the 2 puzzles (that you likely got the game for) are sad compared to their ads. They saw the puzzles were selling so quick threw some in their game so they could be part of the lemmings flocking to the new shiny. Re: as in spend a ton more money, yep.

They steal money from players, and allow other players to do the same. Some things in this game cost 50 thousand dollars to acquire. There are achievements in this game that are needed to progress and get important items for your keep that cost tens of thousands of dollars to be able to qualify. There are very important additions to your keep that show up once and never come back, and cost hundreds of dollars. They even allow 3rd party programs and buying if you spend enough.

They allow bot usage. Several people on our server get away with bots. Overall, this is a puzzle game. You pay enough to have all the right pieces you are unbeatable. THIS IS A PAY TO PLAY GAME. The creators toss out a small amount, but you must pay to get the rest. It takes away from the game because a great deal can not be played if you can not pay. They tease with small prices to expensive packages. But it costs thousands to get the competitive pieces. Plus, the game is extremely glitchy.

I've been playing Evony for over 5 years, but lately, the support has been terrible. I play on 2 devices. About three days ago, I updated the game on my phone and lost months of progress. It restarted at level 1 with a new ID. Luckily, my PC game is still intact, but I don't know for how long. Both devices are linked to the same Gmail account. I've written several emails, opened multiple support tickets, and I only receive the same automated response asking for the same information

The game is good to play to burn time. Buying packages is a hit and miss type thing, sometimes you get everything sometimes you don't and it literally takes 3 days or longer to get back to you. If they get back to you they say you got everything you purchased. Knowing you didn't. The timers don't function correctly and you have to use alot of speed ups. Most people are correct about the puzzles. They are nothing like the ad. P.S I did contact customer support and still didn't take care of issues

Game let's you try some stages but it comes to a point which you must buy membership for $19.99 to soon into a game to spend that much. I just want to fight not build farmhouses and make repairs. I don't want to be a person who wants to go through a long-term journey on this game. What I could play was decent and good graphics very detailed and easy to understand. I am just not a player thar wants to do all the stuff other than battle not train troops. Asked for money way to soon.

They have perfected the art of separating you from your money. Beware the only way to get to high levels and big armies is to have a large wallet. This game plays on your pride so you will get hit and than want revenge. The only way to get revenge is to level up and get better armies. Expect to pay through the nose... It really sucks... it is a decent game if the leveling and getting armies was reasonable. No one should have to spend $500 on this game just to get to level 27 out of 40.

This game is dumb, just a bunch of random people announcing or making up the rules to the game in a world chat. The puzzles in the ads are a tiny, tiny aspect to the game, completely different from the main gameplay. The actual game is a build and conquer type of aspect, but you can only "conquer" during certain days and people or else you get "in trouble for breaking the rules". Then during those specific times it's just a bunch of people crying in a chat that they got attacked. So dumb.

I was unable to get the game to fully load. It starts up and asks you to choose a race, and then I cannot proceed past a splash page, even after rebooting the phone. It is definitely a different game from what the ads look like.. another review mentioned this is a city builder and the puzzles show up later.. I just wanted to play the puzzles, so that and the fact it is not starting means I would not recommend this game to anyone. What makes the ads misleading is they only show the puzzles. Also, as mentioned the game never loaded on my phone, which is an up to date S10+.

It was fun for awhile but as others have written, you get destroyed frequently by higher level players making it extremely difficult to get past a certain level of growth in the game. Puzzles are a very minor part of the game. "kill events" and "server wars" are the main events where you have to struggle to survive or sit there in a "bubble" (i.e. Truce agreement). Completely agree with others saying there needs to be a way to opt out of KE and SVS wars to concentrate on growing.

game is not as advertised. I have no access to the game in the ads, just castle style age of empires wannabe style game edited to respond. only if you start on a new server are you able to access the advertised portion of the game. the fact that they said "keep exploring" should tell you that it is so deeply hidden it's not actually the main focus of the game. your support is nonexistent.

This game has the puzzles like the ads show, but the ads don't show you the copy-and-paste kingdom building aspect about it. You only get to play the puzzles a few times every day. And, the kingdom-building part is pretty bad. It takes you a long time to build up all your power, but one nap can make you lose all your progress. It forces you to play all the time or pay if you want to keep playing what was advertised.

Absolutely false advertising. They'll add the same copy paste response saying I'm wrong as they are to everyone else. I deleted the app and then downloaded it again and started playing just do I could write this review. I did play through enough to get a couple of the puzzles... And they are terrible. Not as advertised. Unlike the ads, the graphical quality is early 2000s. I wish I could block all of their annoying ads.

This game is just a pay to win game. I played for about three weeks and focus on defense of my city. One super high level player came and killed half my army and I didn't kill one person in their attack. They allow you to bubble that makes it so people can't attack which you get a couple free ones but then you need to pay. The game also advertised as puzzle game which it isn't. Shame because it could be a fun game if they made balances to their combat system.

I kept getting bombarded with ads for this game, claiming that "this is the game that is just like its ads". This is blatantly false advertising! The puzzle gameplay shown in the ads is only a small part of the Evony app. I wanted to play a puzzle game, not a conquest game. Also, the choice of cultures is limited to USA, Europe (England?), Russia, China, Japan, Korea, and Arabia. No India, Africa, Latin America, or indigenous empires. Shameful omissions of lots of the world.

I have become a bit disillusioned with the game & the way they charge for "extras." Example, you used to be able to get a new decorative march when finishing a 6 day trial along with other items, a 4.99 to 19.99 purchase. Now you HAVE to spend $99 to get a new march. This is a source of contention with most other players I speak to about this. Also, updating the app when playing on Google Play Windows version is impossible. And without updates you don't get access to all the trials.

pay-to-play time drainer - The game is advertised as both a strategy game & a zombie killing game, neither of those things is the crux of what takes place. Buy packs, & level up. Customer service is non-existent when game gets glitchy or you have any type of problem. You MUST spend money to keep up with other players. The only time you will get any response from customer service is when you write a review. Trouble tickets mean nothing.

Definitely not like the ads. Totally different game. They have a few puzzles similar to the add, but they are a very limited number of mini games within a totally different game. In the two months I played, i never saw a single one of the scenes in the add. The game you end up playing isn't too bad, but it's an army building battle game that is totally pay to win.

I only downloaded this game just so I could leave a review. Stop with the ads everywhere I go. Nobody cares if this game has a pull the pin puzzle it's annoying. This game is really just another boring "build your kingdom" game with a side puzzle every so often. Pulling the pin puzzle is not the main thing for the game. Your ads don't even show the other part of the game you just want to trick people into thinking they're downloading just a puzzle game but in reality it's a joke. Not star worthy

DO NOT SPEND MONEY IN THIS GAME!!!! I have spent quite a bit of money, which is really the only way of advancing, once you reach a certain point. I bought a package and did not receive the items, and have gotten no where with customer support. I'm going to have to dispute charges with my bank and still don't know where this will get me. Luckily, i have a witness that can attest to the fact that the items were not received. I strongly advise against anyone spending money in this game!!!

This is not a game, the (Chinese) owner only wants your money! The mysterious puzzle they advertise with ends at level 17, the rest is 'coming soon'. If you don't spend enough, you can't defend your city and will be destroyed over and over again. Only when you become a slave to the big spenders will you get some protection, but you will have to play their way. The help desk doesn't understand English, they use a machine translation that is flawed, the same machine translation that is in game!!!

I wanted the puzzles where you pull pins, like you see in all the ads. The moment it asked me to gather resources and build on a map, I uninstalled. EDIT: The actual game company left a response to my review, but appears to have misinterpreted my complaint. I don't care that the game has ads. I care that the puzzle that they advertise is not the actual game. It's inherently dishonest of them to only use that part to try and draw me in when that's not the experience they're going to give me.

Click bait. Not a puzzle as advertised, it's a city builder and war game. EDIT: I have played this game since it's inception as a browser game. There has never been a puzzle in it. Currently today there is but it's only for a small portion of the game. It is not the main aspect of how the game is played. Many advertisements running around the mobile game scene, are depicting this game as a puzzle game, which is also shown in the screenshots here as well. 1/5

The ad says something like "tired of game ads luring you in, just find out the game is nothing like the ad?"....then it lures you in with the promise of being a puzzle game, only to find out its a pay to win base builder....garbage In response to your reply: Considering that all I ever see advertised is the puzzles, I would expect it to be a major part of the game. Instead it's a secondary part, that I have yet to encounter, even after a half hour of play...

Let me reiterate, I played until Keep level 22. From the ads I saw, this was a puzzle game. Though this games does have puzzles, the war and fighting part of the game wasn't in the advertisements but it is a very large part of it. Some of the people who play this game are awful and hateful. Save yourself the stress and aggravation, don't play this game.

I played for literally 10 minutes enjoying the puzzles, but they are very easy and started to get boring. Next, there is a bizarre strategy aspect that I did not understand at all. The ads are kind of deceptive as portraying the puzzles as the whole game, but I figured out that very soon you would need to upgrade your resources in order to keep playing them, and looking at other reviews I can see that it could start to take weeks.

I've been seeing ads for this for ages and finally went "a puzzle game doesn't sound too bad right now", and boy was I wrong, firstly the puzzles are only a minor part of the game. Secondly the puzzles are... just stupid, I spent more time trying to deal with the clunky timing than actually having to solve anything. To make it worse it's not even satisfying when I do finish a puzzle

Don't waste your time or get your hopes up. Yes it has puzzles, but more than half of a percentage of the game is a completely different game that is boring and lame. The advertisements all push towards these fun puzzles, and before you can even have fun with the puzzles suddenly you're building an army for a conquering type game. Your advertisements are all about the puzzles, I did not come here for some stupid castle army game. NO ONE ASKED FOR THAT.

The adds lie straight to your face which really bugs me. They act like it's a game all about puzzles and it certainly is not. You can only play a few daily and then a few more at a time after you upgrade things. I was trying to decide between 3 of 4 stars just because of the this, but ended up doing 4 because I like the actual game. It reminds me of games I played when I was younger, but the deception isn't cool. Just advertise the game as what it is. Edit 8/31. Still not a puzzle game 🤣

If you're here because you've seen the ads with the nice puzzles then do not download. That is a shameful click bait from the developers of the game. The puzzles are just a minigame inside, designed to make you play the actual game. It takes long hours playing the game to get to just a few puzzles at a time, and those puzzles are not nearly as elaborate and pretty as the ones you see in the ads. Not recommended if you're looking for a puzzle game.

Extremely misleading from the ads. This is a strategy game. The puzzle game you see in the ads is a tiny portion of this game, is in constant development and is such a tiny portion of the game that if i paid for it i would demand a refund for false advertising. The game itself is a clone of browser based time management strategy games and is set up so that if you dont pay real money at a certain point you just get your ass handed to you constantly. Misleading pay to win game.

It's gotten better, still a disappointment, some of the most important features are only available if you are lucky enough or spend enough to get top 5 in certain events! I left the game in 2021 after playing since 2016 because of it was a waste of time. I couldn't get enough stuff to get past k26, new version makes it easier to get resources and gems, however above k30 looks very disappointing. That's why I'm leaving the game again. It's pointless to play when I can't get the things to compete?

FAKE CLICKBAIT ADS! Nothing like advertised! What's the point of showing a puzzle game ad, where if someone's truly interested in it they click to download... But then it's some RTS resource-management war game instead? Advertise what it is, not what it isn't. This is a disservice to the game itself (maybe it's good, but it's not finding its REAL audience) & to those of us who just wanted what we came here for. There's no way I'll support a company that deceives people. Take down those false ads

Took a break for a couple years, was excited to see the game still around and wanted to try it again. Used to be a high ranking player even spent alot. However I'm sad to see what the game has devolved into. The puzzles are extremely irritating not because they are difficult at all but they feel like they are shoved down your throat. Feels like Evony just wanted to jump on the ad puzzle bandwagon but that was a terrible idea. They need a separate game for the old style.

After seeing a TON of ads for this game, I gave it a try. It's marketed as a puzzle game, but in reality, it's an incredibly convoluted mashup of RTS elements and the loathed "pay to speed things up" microtransaction trap, just to play the puzzles. Some of the puzzles I played were fun, but WAY too much of the game has nothing to do with them.

Edit: they admitted to it. "Dear player. You will find many puzzles when you upgrade your Keep to certain levels. It is a strategy game, so it needs some time to explore" So they fully admit that the game they advertise as a puzzle game is in fact a strategy game, using the same design as all the other money sink games with a new interface.: Not the game shown, They literally advertise this as "the game shown" and then you go to play it and it isn't anything like shown pure click bait

Played this game for 5 years. Unless you have a fortune to spend, don't bother downloading. It is strictly a pay to win game. The ads that you see are for side events. The main part of the game just building things and waiting for them to finish. If for some reason you need to reach customer service, don't expect a response. Every year the game becomes more and more expensive. I finally got sick of all the pay walls, quit and deleted the game. Smartest move I have made in 5 years.

It's a really nice game. I love strategy games involving castles, troops, generals, and others. I've been playing this game for about 3 years now. It's really addictive. However, I rated it 3 stars because it's a pay to win game. Anyone willing to purchase any items in the game could just rise from the weakest to the strongest one a server. Some servers are better than others due to use of abusive languages. You could loss everything in seconds and have to start all over.

As described in other reviews, not what was advertised. Its just another city builder when I was looking for a puzzle game. The puzzle games are just side quests.. Weather or not more puzzles become active as you explore, the ad was still quite deceitful on this matter. So be aware of this when you choose to play this game. WILL UPDATE THIS REVIEW AFTER A MORE IN DEPTH PLAYTHROUGH.

The ads make this look like a puzzle game. I give it 2 stars because the puzzles were genuinely fun to solve. However, most of the game is city battles against other players. You can't access more puzzles until you level up your city and army. It's only a matter of time until you end up targeted by a bully with a city 10 or 100 times larger than yours. They'll raid you over and over. It becomes impossible to level up anything because you need to rebuild and heal troops. Not fun.

The game is a complete money grab. I played for several months. The puzzles are such a small aspect of the game that you spend little to no time on them. I was on a brand new server but a couple of players were already at max level, likely employees. The max level players attack other players encouraging them to spend to grow bigger. The mechanics of the game are way off and the game has serious lag problems which could result in significant losses.

Freezes after first round, can't do anything after that, uninstalled. "TG Inc. Dear player. I have passed your device to our technical team and they will check it. Sorry for the game experience and you can contact our support for solving your issue faster." *EDIT* TG Inc's response does not change my review in the least as it does not solve the issue. According to other reviews, this game has had issues for a while, if you want to sell a game, then make it work 100%, 100% of the time.

Game is programed to "glitch" frequently when opening gold and resources boxes...it takes the boxes, but does not give the gold. I have verified this multiple times, and on different accounts. customer support is incompetent, useless, and does not seem to have a very good grasp of the English language... I have yet to receive any compensation, apologies for their ineptitude, or reassurances of corrections to be made

The ads showing it as a puzzle game say "This is just like it shows in the ads." That's a lie. The puzzles are a SMALL part of the game. It's mostly a kingdom-builder game. You also *have to be part of an alliance* to access some of the content and if you don't you've got nobody to avenge you when you get picked on in PvP. I don't want to have to build farms, sawmills, quarries, and a bunch of other stuff (and upgrade them repeatedly) to be able to do the puzzles. IT'S NOT FUN FOR ME!

After giving this a second try I've decided that this game is nothing more than a cash sponge. The puzzles that you see in the advertisements do not exist in the actual game. Also the puzzle section of the game is one minor part of it and the rest is pretty much a digital social dungeons and dragons scenario. You will have to achieve quests and and purchase materials and supplies and constantly be upgrading your generals and troops all of which cost a copious amount of money. No thanks.

If you're getting this game to solve the puzzles, know that you will be spending less than 1% of your time actually solving puzzles. The vast majority of time is spent building your kingdom. A more even ratio would be acceptable, but spending hours building your empire in order to spend several minutes solving puzzles, then spending a weekend updating your kingdom in order to spend several minutes solving puzzles, so on and so forth? Way overly complex and frustrating for my preference.

The advertising for this game was inaccurate. It's actually not a casual puzzle solving game. The puzzles are only a small part of the game play. I wouldn't have gotten it if I knew that. And the kingdom building part is a little unoriginal. A different type of gameplay would be better, like maybe a combat game where puzzles unlock new gear. But that's only one idea.

How hard is it to make a the simple game we all want. Apparently very. This game has those puzzles sure...but also adds a TON of other stuff that makes you want to uninsured. There are "characters" who talk to you. Little battles, and a bunch of other stuff that is just awful and unnecessary. Waste of time. Disappointment.

False advertising at its finest. I thought this was a puzzle game. Turns out it was way different. A godamm giant lack of puzzles. I get it there are puzzles further in, but if you're gonna do puzzles, at least put in a puzzle mode. Update: Thanks for responding, and I get it. There are puzzles further in. But if you guys added in a puzzle mode, I will give a 5 star rating. But for right now, I will be waiting patiently for it.

It would be nice if the advertisements for this game showed the other 90% of the game. You solve the puzzle to get treasure to build your army. And the easy looking puzzles are just that, easy. Many will have you frustrated on the timing of pulling the pin, but that's it (as far as I was willing to play, anyway). The similarities between this game and "Top War" are way too many given the advertisements for the two. Bait-and-switch, very annoying.

It's a pay-to-win game. Concept is good and strategic but Developers over time just kept on adding more stuff,.supposedly to make things more exciting, but mainly so players can spend more monthly. The social aspect of the game is nice bec you get to chat with different people from across the globe. It was a great game to play during the pandemic, but not anymore. Too many things to do and too hard to level up.

This game is not at all like the ads. Don't waste your time. They will likely respond to this review trying to claim it is like their ads. Their response making such a claim will be a bald faced lie. They should be purged from the store for false advertising. This listing, as currently represented, is little more than a bait and switch scam. Edit: As predicted, they did respond trying to claim their game is fairly represented. They missed the point entirely. Their ads represent the game as a puzzle game. It is not a puzzle game. It is a real-time strategy MMO game, taking place in a persistent world. This means anyone can march towards your castle at any time to wreck what you have, and you can't access the puzzles this game has until you’ve built and upgraded your castle so that you can venture into ancient ruins to hunt for treasure (the puzzles serve as the treasure hunt mechanic). Simply put, this is not the game their ads show. This is an ill-conceived attempt at making a horribly executed MMO-RTS interesting to players by adding a poorly executed puzzle feature that you have to build up for real-world days in order to access. Save your time. Save you money. Stay away.

Not like the ads. The ads show only intellectual based puzzles. You have to pull the right pins in the right order. THAT is why I tried the game. But after a dozen screens or so, new elements appeared. Moving pads, doors that only opened briefly after a lever was pulled, etc. So now you have to use agility, timing, etc, to complete each screen. I dislike those kind of games. Had I known that in advance, I would not have downloaded.

The pop-ups on this game are ridiculous! I got completely zeroed because of the pop showing during the server vs. server. I couldn't bubble up. What waste of money, I spend hundreds and lose it all because of your moronic pop-ups, and I get no reimbursement for my loss. That's because of you guys. Let's also not forget that all your packs that you sell are so outdated, update it. Same with the generals that the new servers can get, but older ones won't see.

Initially a fun game. Sub games are a sub plot. It is otherwise a atypical MMO. It tends to be be more toxic as Devs don't address the the disparity between high and low levels. Expect as a beginner. To be battered for months by more advanced players. Progress will be minimal, thus Progress will be slow to non existence. I thank the alliance I was initially setup with,but totally a failure in the the long run due to the the rules or the lack there of in the long. Game at your own risk. Peace.

The customer support is terrible. The game started fun but after I spent a lot money and time they change the game into something that requires money to keep playing. One way they do this is with the "Truce bubble". They make it harder as time progresses to aquire one without purchases. That's how they hook you on buying. Every three days you'll have to renew a truce bubble or lose your game progress. I had to drag my notebook with on vacation or lose my game progress.

The game is not as advertised. Js. Update, since this thing decided to chime in months later. The core game play isn't what you see in ads. What you are shown is a game that you have time to figure out how a puzzle to which you win the girl, loot, etc. Where the game actually goes is that you are given a level and you are moving, without control, in a predictable pattern, THAN you can move pieces or parts of the environment, as shown. 500 words/letters aren't enough to explain my disappo...

Game is clunky and largely uninteresting, in my opinion. It keeps advertising the puzzles and says it was the original game that had them, but the puzzles themselves are just a part of the main game which is a city builder/resource management sim. Graphics of the puzzle don't look as polished as the ads as well. As much as this game tried to sell itself as unique due to the puzzles, it's not really. It's generic like all the others with just one more gimmick under the hood.

{Edited} The game is totally awesome...sure the ads that kept popping up in other games were annoying. I downloaded it for puzzles but it's more like 1% puzzle yet I'm addicted. It's totally awesome. The game is really addicive and fun. Not much pressure and definitely not pay-to-win. You don't have to play it all day. It's both competitive and casual. Definitely deserves 6 stars. After 2 years of playing, I take it back. Save yourself, don't press that download button...

It's a pay to play game. Though it is still doable to progress when you go in without spending (you just gotta have wealthy allies). I always say this game is for those with money and time (its like having a second job). It's a fun game but can get absolutely addicting and worse when you start spending. $5 a week turns into 20-100$. I enjoyed playing it for a year til I just had to stop spending and the slow progress made me lose interest. There are always new events which keeps it fun.

Played for about a year, managed to get to Keep 35. At the time I stopped, Keep 40 was max, not sure now. But it got to the point it was either grind for months or pay crazy amounts of money to progress, and progress can easily be lost if you forget to bubble up. The bubble only has to be down for a minute or two to lose days or weeks worth of resource gain. Fun early, pay to win (or even progress) later game.

This game is a total disappointment. Having played this game begrudgingly for a solid month only to give up on the reward I was aiming for to progress in a different game, I can agree with everyone who says that the devs lie in their marketing. The constant ads are extremely misleading, and even when they aren't, the quality is much worse vs what the ads show you. Also, the game has no consistent structure, as based on their ads, they mash together elements that don't work well together.

False advertising at its finest! I see ads for this game all the time presenting it as a puzzle game and saying "are you tired of all the games that are nothing like ads, then download evony" this is exactly the negative things their ads talk about other games lol. I decided to download the game, and it let me play a 5 second puzzle type of thing then wanted me to start building things and stuff. Not what it's supposed to be. Don't waste your time downloading!

I had an enjoyable experience for the longest time, but forcing everyone to pay money into the experience drove me down to zero quickly. The puzzle part of this game is cute (the part you see in the ads). Unfortunately most of your time will be spent playing the strategy part, which is tiresome and poorly designed. Dont waste your time on this one. Edit: Years later and this stupid game is still getting downloaded. They made new ads for it too, in which they lie about the content. Boring. Got to Keep level 11 and ran out of items to reduce construction time on things. Construction time rocketed up from there. Puzzle solving aspect isn't even fun or hard, seems mostly like padding. Can't even play it solo because it's unlocked by keep progress. Menus are difficult to navigate and unclear about what the game mechanics are. Tries to hook you with lots of gifts so you'll sink money into it. Play Fate: Grand Order, Sid Meyer's Civilization, or Farmville instead.

The game is ok. But building up gets ridiculously expensive and takes way too long to complete/expensive to speed up. And the constant pop-ups of the ads and events are getting REALLY annoying! Every time I try to tap on a building or do something, the event keeps popping up, and I have to exit of and retap what I was trying to do in the first place. It's basically a pay to win game. And the pull the pin games are all the same every day, if not, every other day.

I will give you all an honest review from a mid level spender perspective. I've been playing Evony for a little over 3 years now. When I first started, it was a very challenging game. You didn't need to spend a fortune to build strength. It was more simplistic but still complex. Now the game has strictly become monetized to squeeze every penny out of every player. I wish I could write more but I'm limited to 500 words. What did it for me was the new relic feature. It's literally a joke.

Ad says it all...just ignore the words. Basic puzzles that rely on hand eye coordination and timing to be challenging because the puzzles are basic. Except it's not a puzzle game it's a linear progression resource grinder. This game is only different from 1000 other games like it, because of the puzzles which are barely puzzles in most cases. Skip it.

Game is actually a brilliant war strategy game. My current issue is that it takes way to long to upgrade items after keep 26. To go to keep 28...it will take 151 days....that's almost a 1/2 year. Then walls will take probably 60-70 days. It's reaching the point where it's more irritating than a great game. My other issue is when you do have an issue, customer service keeps sending a bot generic response...then after 3 weeks the ticket is closed without resolution

It's not a puzzle game, this is a side challenge in the game to lure you in. It's really a war game where you build up your castle and troops and fight other players. But beware the game glitches a lot and the customer service is sub-par. Also a lot of ads and to progress to get any of the top rewards you have to spend a lot of money and time.
This game helps relieve my anxiety and stress it's a great 👍 game

I was digging this game big time! Had spent about $60 in a month. It continuously prompted me to update it, but said my Android lacked the space on 5/20/22. So late that morning I deleted a game I'd been playing previously and proceeded with the update. The game hasn't loaded since and I have done everything I can think of on my end. This was the best war strategy game, at the begininng. It started to go down hill after they added refining. Then things just got worse when they added the wonder. It's not a puzzle game. They're a small part of the game, and their challenge is twitchy rather than intellectual. It's a PvP wargame, so it required HUGE attention to keep up. You cannot let it go and come back to it. The map is littered with level 2 players that were looking for a puzzle game and quit. As others have said, troublesome interface and language translation, and I would add *fundamentally dishonest.* I made a small purchase within the game (a specific set of items that constitute the "St. Patricks Day Special"), but I did not receive the items that were promised in that package. I tried to submit a support ticket to Customer Service (asking them to please give me the correct package that I paid for, or to refund my money), and I even sent an email to Customer Service. Regardless, they never corrected the mistake - I never received the package that I paid for, nor did I receive a refund - so I'll be disputing the charge. Clearly they must believe that enough new people will keep joining the game that they don't need to worry about honoring the existing players. Don't waste your time (or money) on this game.

Nice at first fast growth. BUT once you hit level 24 it's dead slow taking months to reach just one level. This game glitches all the time when you are upgrading. You will use your resources but nothing will get upgraded. Then you contact customer support and they do nothing to help you. What kind of morons schedule a long update in the early morning hours. And the puzzles in the commercials are BS. Not that the game is horrible, for what it actually is, but it almost fair to say the ads they have everywere constitute false advertising.

Terrible for a puzzle game and a sorry excuse for a strategy game. It feels like this game is so confused as to what it should be. The advertisements are pretty misleading and don't represent what this game actually contains. Loaded with tons of things that will make you want to spend a lot on micro-transaction upgrades. Not worth your time. Edit after developer response: The developer often responds on many of these comments with "We have same content in the game as advertised." These comments by myself and many others are not because we did not play. It is because an advertisement that ONLY shows a puzzle game and not the rest of the awful game is misleading. Nobody is saying the puzzles aren't there. They are just a small slice of the game. The bulk of the game is not shown, likely because of how awful it really is. The puzzles, when you do get to play them for the small percentage of time that you are actually given them are not challenging, very buggy and just silly little diversions. I was told in my review response by the developer to "keep playing" or I might miss that content as if I didn't even get there. Oh, I did... I got to the puzzles. I did not "miss" them for sure. I gave this a fair shot and it really isn't worth my time and I definitely don't think it is worth anyone else's time either. There's better games out there that don't mislead, hide content, and offer a much nicer experience. If you are looking for the puzzle game as depicted in the video and images of this game, you will likely only get to do these silly puzzles for a small percentage of the time while you MUST engage with other non-puzzle content that will bombard you with microtransaction opportunities.

The game is glitchy but fine. People in the game make it better (server 1090 is great if you want to meet some of them). Customer service is awful. The ads don't reflect the main content of the game at all. The puzzles play a very small part of the actual gameplay. A new ad has come up showing what looks like a fun arcade like shooter. I hate the ads about Evony too, they are misleading and the puzzles in the ads are a gimmick to draw you in. There are puzzles, but you have to wait to develop the civilization to play them.

Avoid this game. Advertisements make you think it is puzzles. That is the smallest and least meaningful part. It is a war game and in game purchases are almost a must to succeed. This game will cost you $100s to $1000s every month to be competitive. Customer service is terrible and the game is full of bugs. Save yourself, do not download!

For the record, the ads you see do not accurately reflect the primary gameplay loop; Evony is a "Clash of Clans" style wargame with the puzzle fare you see in the ads being OPTIONAL minigames. Be advised: This isn't new for the brand.
